name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accidental death and disability insurance cover for bank account holders
benefit_description: Rs 2 lakh accidental death cover, Rs 1 lakh partial disability cover
action: Enroll at any bank branch or Common Service Centre
official_source: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
deadline: Renews every June 1st — must re-enroll annually
